[SWS_CM_10325] Identifying the right event
⌈
Using the Service ID (see [PRS_-
SOMEIP_00040]) and the serviceInterfaceId attribute of the SomeipServi-
ceInterfaceDeployment element as well as the Event ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_-
00040]) and the eventId attribute of the SomeipFieldDeployment.notifiers
of the SomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment, the right event shall be identi-
fied.
